name: list_recent_changes
title: List what changed on an API
description: Explains a problem by what was done in the control plane: deployments, starts and stops of the API, and its audit trail (plans, subscriptions, API keys, members, definition), each with the user who did it. Call it with a window that covers the onset of the problem and compare timestamps: a change seconds or minutes before the onset is the first suspect. Default window: 1h.

environment.description: Id, HRID or name of an environment of your organization. Omit when `api` names an API that exists in only one environment you can read, or when you can read only one.

api.description: Id or exact name of an API. Use the id when several APIs share a name.

window.description: Length of the time range to look at, ending at `until`: a number followed by m, h or d. Default 1h.

until.description: End of the time range as an ISO-8601 UTC instant, for example 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z. Default: now. Set it to look at a past incident.

event.description: For example PUBLISH_API, PLAN_UPDATED, SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED, APIKEY_REVOKED.

actor.description: The user who made the change.

details.description: What the change applies to, by type: PLAN, APPLICATION, API_KEY (the key id, never its value).

omittedSources.description: Sources you are not allowed to read. When not empty, an empty `changes` does not mean nothing changed.
